Privacy

Privacy policy

IndieLab keeps data collection minimal. This site does not require accounts and does not sell personal information.

Analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand which guides readers find useful. Google Analytics uses cookies to measure visits in aggregate. You can opt out with the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on.

Advertising & affiliate links

Outbound product links go to Amazon and carry an affiliate tag so purchases can be attributed. Amazon's own privacy policy governs what happens on their site. If advertising (such as Google AdSense) is enabled in future, this policy will be updated before it runs.

Contact

Questions about this policy: reach us through the Pinterest profile linked from our guides.
